author: pmarca
text:
Anyone can get my friend’s real SSN from Claude

I'm Terrified of my data in training sets. Emails in databases. iMessages harvested. Cant trust the cloud as AI is crazy good at hacking

So I built Underdog for myself: on-device AI OS. Capable & 100% local. now my friends love it
